# Matic Issue Workflow
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Next action: list open issues labeled `matic`, acquire one atomic GitHub claim, and start the lowest-scoring simplest issue only after the claim is verified. After each PR is created, publish a verified screenshot comment addressed to the issue author.

## Purpose

Handle one selected GitHub issue per invocation through the existing Lead Hub build pipeline, with an atomic shared GitHub claim, PM Control preparation before implementation, reconciliation before quality measurement, a reviewed PR to `staging`, and explicit issue closure after merge.

## Trigger

Run this workflow when the user asks to:

- run the next issue labeled `matic`;
- resume a recorded matic run;
- check a matic PR or review feedback;
- close the related issue after a matic PR merges.

Do not run it when the request is a normal application build request, a production deployment request, or an issue without the `matic` label.

## Interface Contract

```text
GitHub issue, PR, and claim state + project context + existing build stages -> select, atomically claim, execute, verify, publish, and close one authorized issue -> run evidence, PM Control updates, PR, claim history, and issue state
```

| Interface | Declaration |
|---|---|
| Inputs | Open GitHub issues labeled `matic`, current PR and review state, remote Matic claim refs, repository source, project controls, approved scope, and existing stage outputs |
| Transform | Orchestrate one issue through selection, plan-control, Define, Design, Build, Reconcile, Measure, Learn, Publish, and post-merge closure |
| Outputs | Inspectable run evidence, relevant PM Control updates, one verified claim history, one reviewed PR targeting `staging`, an author-addressed issue comment with a safe fix screenshot, and issue closure only after verified merge |

## Routing

| Request | Route | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Run next matic issue | `stages/01-select/CONTEXT.md` | Ranked candidates, one atomic claim, and one selected issue run |
| Resume an active matic run | Recorded `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md` | Continue from the recorded stage |
| Prepare issue plan and controls | `stages/02-plan-control/CONTEXT.md` | Execution plan, acceptance matrix, and pre-build PM Control updates |
| Define the selected issue | `../stages/01-define/CONTEXT.md` | Existing cycle definition and handoff |
| Design the selected issue | `../stages/02-design/CONTEXT.md` | Existing environment gate and solution design |
| Execute the selected issue | `../stages/03-build/CONTEXT.md` | Existing source change and build handoff |

## Matic Sequence

```text
01-select -> 02-plan-control -> 01-define -> 02-design -> 03-build -> 04-reconcile
-> 04-measure -> 05-learn -> 05-publish (PR + author-addressed screenshot comment) -> 06-close-merged
```

The numbered stages from `workspace/stages/` are the existing build pipeline. The numbered stages under this directory are orchestration stages. `06-close-merged` is independently invoked after publication when GitHub reports a merge or review event.

## Input Gate

- The repository is `adventistasia/lead-lab`.
- A candidate is open and has the exact `matic` label.
- No active run, open PR, or remote claim already owns the candidate unless this is an explicit resume, recovery, handoff, or status request.
- The issue has a clear outcome and acceptance condition.
- The worktree is clean before a new branch is created.
- The required project, environment, authority, and review inputs are available.
- A new run is not created until the exact remote claim is verified.

If any gate fails, do not guess. Use the recorded run state when a run exists; otherwise report that no run was started.

## State And Recovery

- Store matic run artifacts in `application/runs/<date>-matic-issue-<number>-<slug>/`.
- Store the durable state in `{{RUN_PATH}}/run-state.md`.
- Store the durable shared ownership state in `refs/heads/matic-claims/issue-<number>` as defined by `claim-contract.md`.
- Treat the remote claim ref and its history as the ownership source of truth. Treat a copied local run state as evidence only.
- Use a separate clone or worktree for every active execution. An issue claim does not serialize unrelated local checkouts.
- Never delete a claim ref to recover an abandoned run. Use an explicit handoff or takeover reason after confirming the prior execution stopped.
- Use `Blocked` for missing information, access, authority, or human decisions.
- Use `Awaiting review` or `Awaiting merge` for an external PR boundary.
- Use `Paused` only when the user asks to stop or an explicit operator handoff is recorded.
- Resume from the recorded stage. Do not rebuild unaffected stages.

## Completion

The matic workflow is complete only when:

- the selected issue's implementation is reconciled;
- Measure passed and Learn was written;
- the exact intended files were committed and pushed;
- the PR targets `staging` and requests `dennisatssd`;
- the related issue has a verified comment addressed to its author with a safe screenshot of the fix;
- the exact PR is verified merged into `staging`;
- the remote claim is transitioned to `complete`; and
- the related GitHub issue is closed with a traceable comment.
